classification_rule: Ensemble or neural representation capable of nonlinear interactions.
Direct estimation with few controlling choices.
Validation selection or iterative fitting with a bounded candidate set.
Multiple interacting modelling controls, architecture or optimisation choices, or iterative minibatch training.
Native probabilities or link-scale scores followed by the single common validation-fitted sigmoid map.
